title: Routing & Layout Foundation
summary: Set up a clean app shell with routing, navigation, and predictable UI structure.
content:
# Goal
Build a reliable foundation for a frontend app.

## Decisions
- React Router for client-side routing
- A layout shell that hosts navigation and an Outlet

## Learnings
- Keep pages thin
- Move app-shell concerns into src/app

title: Content Model & Local Repository
summary: Model case studies in a typed way and expose a repository API for later backend integration.
content:
# Goal
Represent content as data with strong typing.

## Approach
- JSON as a simple, versioned content store
- Repository functions (getAll/getBySlug)

## Next
Swap JSON for API/CMS without changing the UI layer.

title: Form Validation Patterns (Planned)
summary: Prepare a robust, accessible pattern for form validation and UI states.
content:
# Goal
Implement accessible form validation.

## Planned
- React Hook Form + Zod
- Clear error messages and focus management

## Why it matters
Forms are a common source of UX and quality issues.
